summary: Targeted frontend icon regression verification completed on public URL (desktop + mobile). Inline SVG migration is working and icon rendering is stable.

integration_issues.issue: Observed intermittent request abort to /cdn-cgi/rum (net::ERR_ABORTED); not related to icon rendering and did not affect UI icon behavior.

action_items: No icon regression fix required; keep inline SVG approach.
Optional: monitor preview telemetry aborts (/cdn-cgi/rum) separately from product UI verification.
critical_code_review_comments: Icon generation via script.js iconMarkup + inline SVG geometry is consistent and avoids external sprite dependency risk.
No svg <use> usage and no assets/icons.svg references exist in rendered DOM.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified targeted icon bug scope only. Results: 41 .ui-icon SVGs present, 41/41 include inline geometry, 0 svg use nodes, 0 assets/icons.svg references. Desktop and mobile checks passed for topbar, nav search, hero contact, trust, trade features, quality steps, about benefits, carousel controls, footer/contact/social, modal close, mobile menu open/close icons, mobile social icons, and WhatsApp.
rca of the issue: Original defect likely came from external sprite dependency (<use href='assets/icons.svg#...'>) failing to resolve in deployed pathing/caching. Current implementation replaces that dependency with direct inline SVG geometry injected by script.js, eliminating external sprite lookup and preventing blank icon failures.
